instruction: Stop Ubuntu from enabling the screen lock when the display turns off.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic screen lock. Config sets lock-enabled to true initially, user must change it to false. Evaluator checks gsettings value is 'false'. No custom functions needed - uses existing get_vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter extracts correct state: get_vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.screensaver lock-enabled' which directly retrieves the screen lock setting
Metric comparison is appropriate: exact_match correctly compares the gsettings output string
Expected value is correct: 'false\n' matches the actual output format from gsettings when screen lock is disabled (includes newline)
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the single requirement (disabling automatic screen lock) via the lock-enabled setting
Proper parameter handling: exact_match metric correctly accesses rules['expected'] when expected.type='rule'
